request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply: The newest report checked does not directly quantify a first-of-class ship’s cost overrun against its original baseline. It does provide related Ford-class context: CRS reports a proposed FY2026 request of $3,431.6 million in combined advance procurement, procurement, and cost-to-complete funding (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 7), and a 54-month delay in CVN-79’s estimated delivery (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 15). These are not overrun figures, and this review does not establish whether other official reports provide one. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-154303-8d0e.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The verified findings supply relevant ship-program budget and schedule data but do not answer the core request with an original-versus-current first-of-class cost comparison.
